about: Jez237 multimedia videos. Large masters are served from this repo via GitHub Pages; each one also has a watch page in the jez237.com screening room.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Witte Street
videos.summary: Witte St block lap: Witte, E Pacific, Janney and E Venango, with the new step watcher beside the Bauder garage door.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Aramingo Avenue
videos.summary: Down E Venango and up Aramingo Ave past the lots and stores: a feeder looking up, a horde of 7 crossing E Venango, a shambler tripping, a burnt wreck, a car alarm horde, three closing in on a body, a Screamer, crawlers, the checkpoint's last stand at a barricade, a burning one, one kneeling.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Castor Terminal
videos.summary: Down Castor Ave past the truck terminal (its walls untouched) and right on Tulip: a feed, two pounding a door, a crawler, two beating on a car, a horde crossing Castor, a shambler tripping, a Screamer, a smouldering wreck, feeders looking up, shamblers, one kneeling.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Under the El
videos.summary: DRIZZLE. Up Ruth St, left on E Venango toward the El, under it down Kensington Ave, back along E Atlantic: feeders on Ruth (one rises to watch you), two pounding a rowhome door, a shambler tripping, a crawler at the corner, a group crossing E Venango under the El, a Screamer, a car alarm horde, a feed, one lurching out of a doorway, a burning one, one kneeling in the street.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Frankford & the Rec Centre
videos.summary: Down Pickwick, Amber past the rec centre, E Pacific to Frankford: three closing in on a body against a wall, one beating a car window, a shambler, a group crossing Pickwick, a nest by the rec centre, a Screamer, a feeder looking up, a doorway lurcher, crawlers, a car alarm horde, one kneeling.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Joyce & the Rowhomes
videos.summary: RAIN. Up Joyce, along E Venango, down Emerald, back on E Atlantic: three pounding a door, a feed, a shambler tripping, one beating a car window, a Screamer on the corner, a group crossing E Venango, feeders looking up, a burning one, a doorway lurcher, three closing in on a body, a crawler.

videos.title: Port Richmond — Weikel & Tulip
videos.summary: Down Weikel toward the river side, E Pacific, up Tulip, along E Venango: one kneeling, a car alarm horde, two at a door, crawlers, a feed, a shambler tripping, a nest of sleepers (one wakes), a Screamer with two, a doorway lurcher, a feeder looking up, burning ones.
